name: Flint Park Day Camp
description_short: Village day camp at Flint Park for Larchmont residents and Chatsworth Avenue School students entering kindergarten to 6th grade, six weeks, 9 to 3, with daily swimming, crafts, Color Olympics, a carnival, theater by Sandbox Theatre and nature programming. After camp options add sports, STEM and art.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Day Camp page: 2026 season June 29 to August 7 (no camp July 3), Monday to Friday 9 to 3; open to residents of the Village of Larchmont and Chatsworth Avenue School students, rising kindergartners to rising 6th graders; no refunds; expanded after camp options. No fee is posted. ZIP 10538 is from the Village Hall address in the page footer (120 Larchmont Avenue); the page gives no street address for Flint Park. Ages derived from grades. Outdoor inferred from a park camp with daily swimming.

for_andrew: Only Larchmont village residents and Chatsworth Avenue School students can enroll; nobody else. Andrew's rule for residents only camps: record the one rate, say who can enroll, and ask. List it?
No fee is posted for 2026. List it without a price?
